title: Chicken Fricassee
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged label/USDA unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.
ruled_substitutions: Tarragon -> fresh parsley, SOURCE-SANCTIONED: the source's own ingredient line reads 'If you can't find tarragon, you can use parsley'. Tarragon is ABSENT on the board (no cell, no capture); fresh-parsley is carried 3 of 7. Booking the source's stated fallback is not a mapping stretch.

ingredients.notes: Main protein anchored by an explicit source WEIGHT (2 lb = 1 breast per serving at ~227 g raw), exact 3.5x, zero drift. That is above the catalog's 167 g/serving chicken-breast average, but the source's own published 54 g protein/serving demands it and our recompute lands at 55.3 g (+2.4%) - the florentine each-weight failure mode does not apply when the source states pounds and its protein confirms them. Board 6 of 7, cheapest Baker's $1.99/lb.

kosher-salt commodity exists, 3 of 7 stores, cheapest Walmart $0.0629/oz - no need to flatten to table salt. Zero-macro; grams on the table-salt 6 g/tsp basis (coarse kosher runs lighter; gram error here is macro- and cost-irrelevant).
densities each=110 g. The source line's '(about to 1 cup)' typo (extractor concern) does not change the count basis. Board 7 of 7, cheapest Aldi $0.7967/lb.

DRIFT NOTED: exact 3.5x = 3.5 yolks, rounded UP to 4 whole yolks (+14.3% on this line; +2 cal/serving - a half yolk is not a cook measure). Purchase maps to the eggs commodity (7 of 7, whole eggs); macros book to the NEW Egg Yolk DB row (USDA, 17 g/yolk), not the whole-egg row, because the yolk carries nearly all the fat.

pricing_terms_needed.why: fricassee deglaze/sauce base, 3/4 cup plus 2 tbsp at 14 servings; board and captures have no white-wine cell anywhere, yet several Omaha stores stock wine - needs a real carriage/price verdict

macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS on the protein instrument (+2.4%), which validates every portion including the 2 lb main protein. CALLED OUT LOUDLY: the calorie gap is -23.4%, entirely a FAT gap (17.9 computed vs 31 published). The listed quantities cannot produce 31 g fat/serving from label rows: chicken breast 3 g/112 g raw, 1 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil + 1/3 cup sour cream + 1 yolk across 4 servings totals ~18 g/serving. Their calculator most plausibly booked skin-on breast or double-counted the sauce dairy. Our label-accurate figure stands; if QA prefers the source's calories the recipe would still sit in band, but no label-supported path reaches 569.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 436.1 cal in [400, 650] PASS (36 cal above the floor - note the margin); carbs 11.3 g <= 35 PASS

board_defects_observed: portobello-mushrooms commodity: the single populated cell is a CANNED product (Walmart 'Giorgio Chunky Style Portabella Mushrooms, 4oz Can' normalized to $4.88/lb) on a commodity whose concept is fresh portobello - a form-flip inside the cell. The mapping targets the id (right concept); the cell needs a capture-rule fix. Flagged for the match-soundness/capture pipeline, not changed by this run.
Term 'tarragon' is ABSENT board-wide; recorded here so the herb gap is visible if future recipes need it (this recipe resolved via the source's own parsley fallback).
